data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Khoorsheeda (خرشيدة) translates to 'Lady of the garden'. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'khorsh', which means 'garden', and the suffix '-eeda', which denotes 'lady'. The name is often used for girls in Arabic, Urdu, and Persian cultures.
